p: Blackheath is one of those Black Country towns where the High Street still feels properly local, with independent shops, cafés and the market a short walk away. This Admiral is an adult gaming centre in the thick of it, open only to over 18s.

If you're making more of a day of it, the Black Country Living Museum in Dudley is a short drive away and brings the area's industrial past to life with old shops, a pub, a fair and trams. Closer to home, Haden Hill House and Park in Cradley Heath has a Victorian house and Tudor manor set in parkland with a lake. Rowley Regis station, a little way from the High Street, has trains into Birmingham.
